correctness.rationale: The exact 12-vertex adjacency lists define the complex. Two separate predicates agree on all 4096 subsets and yield 324 faces. A 151-pair acyclic Morse matching is explicitly replayed and fully topologically sorted across all 984 incidences, leaving exactly one critical vertex and 20 critical three-cells, hence the integral wedge of 20 three-spheres. Independent mod-two chain ranks confirm the Betti dimensions. For each of 120 graph automorphisms, the rational chain-character Lefschetz formula is computed, yielding the A5 × C2 decomposition through exact irreducible character comparison; the automorphism group completeness follows from a vertex-stabilizer order bound.

value.rationale: The standard dissociation/second-independence complex of the canonical twelve-vertex regular icosahedron is a motivated natural simplicial object. The complete nonequivariant integral homotopy type and full rational representation under icosahedral symmetries are structural invariants not supplied by extremal dissociation numbers, ordinary independence, or neighborhood complexes. In particular the invariant line and 15/5 antipodal eigenspaces explain nontrivial symmetry features of the newly classified topology.
